papers.title: HYDRA-X: Native Unified Multimodal Models with Holistic Visual Tokenizers
papers.abstract: Unified multimodal model integrating image and video tokenization within a single Vision Transformer, addressing spatiotemporal reconstruction and semantic awareness through causal temporal attention and hierarchical compression.

papers.title: VIA-SD: Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Multi-tier speculative decoding framework using intra-model routing with slim submodels for medium-confidence token validation, achieving significant speedups over traditional approaches without training modifications.

papers.title: Where, What, Why, and Importance: Structured Defect Grounding for Text-to-Image Feedback
papers.abstract: Proposes Structured Defect Grounding to diagnose text-to-image model failures as structured set prediction, using vision-language models for detection and box-derived spatial rewards for diffusion model alignment.

papers.title: From 2D Grids to 1D Tokens: Reforming Shared Representations for Multimodal Image Fusion
papers.abstract: Multimodal image fusion using compact 1D token interface from pretrained image tokenizer to enhance global appearance coherence while preserving local details through selective token editing.

papers.title: TreeSeeker: Tree-Structured Trial, Error, and Return in Deep Search
papers.abstract: Inference-time framework organizing search as branch-and-return over tree-structured states, using textual UCB signals to manage exploration-exploitation tradeoffs in deep search tasks.

papers.title: Risk Under Pressure: Compute-Aware Evaluation of Adversarial Robustness in Language Models
papers.abstract: Compute-aware evaluation framework using FLOPs and risk-compute curves revealing non-monotonic effects of alignment training and varying attack costs across different harm categories in language models.

papers.title: Rethinking Psychometric Evaluation of LLMs: When and Why Self-Reports Predict Behavior
papers.abstract: Examines psychometric assessment of LLM behavior, showing Theory of Planned Behavior achieves human-level coherence within shared conversations while broad personality frameworks prove inadequate for deployment behavior testing.

papers.title: See What I See, Know What I Think: Dense Latent Communication Across Heterogeneous Agents
papers.abstract: Heterogeneous multi-agent systems achieve effective knowledge transfer through aligned KV-cache communication with cross-model latent alignment, matching text-based methods at 2-3x lower computational cost.

papers.title: Getting Better at Working With You: Compiling User Corrections into Runtime Enforcement for Coding Agents
papers.abstract: TRACE pipeline mines user corrections into atomic rules compiled as runtime checks, reducing preference violations from 100% to 2% on out-of-distribution tasks without retraining agents.

papers.title: WebChallenger: A Reliable and Efficient Generalist Web Agent
papers.abstract: Web agent framework using PageMem structured representation to replicate human cognitive advantages in selective attention, persistent memory, and procedural fluency, achieving 56.3% on WebArena with open-weight models.

cc_updates.body:
Session titles are now generated in the language of your conversation (set the `language` setting to pin a specific language)
Added `footerLinksRegexes` setting for regex-matched link badges in the footer row, configurable via user or managed settings
Improved Bedrock credential caching: credentials from `awsCredentialExport` are now cached until their `Expiration` instead of a fixed 1 hour
Fixed `availableModels` enforcement: alias model picks can no longer be redirected to a blocked model via `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL` environment variables, and `/fast` now refuses to toggle when it would switch to a model outside the allowlist
Fixed auto mode failing on Fable 5 for organizations without Opus 4.8 enabled — the classifier now falls back to the best available Opus model
Fixed hook `if` conditions for Read/Edit/Write tool paths: documented patterns like `Edit(src/**)`, `Read(~/.ssh/**)`, and `Read(.env)` now match correctly
Fixed Linux sandbox failing to start when `.claude/settings.json` is a symlink with an absolute target
Fixed `/copy` and mouse-selection copy not reaching the system clipboard inside tmux over SSH, and tmux paste buffer not loading on versions older than 3.2
Fixed Remote Control connecting from web/mobile silently switching the session model
Fixed Remote Control disconnect notifications showing a bare numeric code instead of a human-readable reason, and connection failures adding a duplicate line to the conversation transcript

Added `enforceAvailableModels` managed setting — when enabled, the `availableModels` allowlist also constrains the Default model (a Default that would resolve to a disallowed model now falls back to the first allowed model), and user or project settings can no longer widen a managed `availableModels` list
